summary: While changing the main section headings to dark blue appears intentional, the footer contact text also changed from white to dark blue against a bright blue background, causing a severe contrast and readability defect.

regressions.explanation: The text 'Contact us at: info@educationalinstitute.com' changed from white to dark blue against the medium-blue footer background, resulting in very low contrast and poor legibility compared to the white social media text above it.
